transformation: inverse keyed-alphabet index relabeling: keyed alphabet letter -> A-Z at same index

shuffled_control.method: uniform random permutation of stream characters; exact character multiset preserved
shuffled_control.interpretation: Descriptive conditional control only, not a p-value or independent evidence. The target signature was observed after inspecting this stream, and selection across delimiters, alphabets, transformations, orientations, and other patterns is not accounted for.

rotation_control.interpretation: Circular-alignment sensitivity check only. The target segment lengths were observed from this same stream, so this is not an independent significance test.

historical_baseline.source: Official Urania World Clock history page; original display described as 80 city names across 24 time zones.
historical_baseline.interpretation: The 92 non-delimiter letters do not map one-to-one to the documented 80 original city names without an additional, independently justified rule.

limitations: The inverse keyed-alphabet relabeling and X delimiter choice are a specified candidate, not an established K4 mechanism.
The segment lengths are not a match to the documented 80-city original display.
No physical plate order, UTC assignment, clock orientation, or plaintext is inferred.
A crib-conditioned fit is not independent validation; rotation and shuffled controls are descriptive only and do not account for hypothesis-selection bias.
